title: insert_outbound_message sets next_attempt_at to now() instead of immediate 0
description: When a new outbox row is inserted, next_attempt_at is set to the current time rather than 0 (or epoch). This means the first delivery attempt is delayed by however long until the next outbox_tick fires instead of being attempted immediately. Fix: use 0 or a past timestamp for next_attempt_at on initial insert so the first tick picks it up immediately.
